description: Gold verdicts for the claim_verification questions: what a correct answer should conclude from the ORKG records. 'accept' lists every verdict counted as correct. If none of 'key_papers' is in the LLM context, INSUFFICIENT is accepted as well, since the deciding evidence was not retrieved. MIXED questions are left out of verdict accuracy.
status: reviewed — verdicts proposed by Claude from the ORKG records of the gold-set papers, reviewed and approved by the author on 2026-10-19

Q16.evidence: BoolQ: BERT-MultiNLI 80.4 vs BiDAF-MultiNLI 75.57, BiDAF+ELMo 71.41, majority 62.17 accuracy. The BERT paper records alone hold only BERT's own SQuAD scores, with no baseline.

Q17.evidence: Transformer BLEU on WMT14 En-De (28.1-29.5) and IWSLT, but the LSTM models in the same papers are scored only on language modelling (perplexity). No Transformer vs LSTM result on the same translation task.

Q18.evidence: No paper reports ResNet and VGG on ImageNet side by side (Dspike: spiking VGG-16 71.24 top-1 on ImageNet, ResNet-18 only on CIFAR). Cross-paper numbers (ResNet-200 79.9 top-1) point to SUPPORTED but are not comparable setups.

Q19.evidence: Papers do augmentation for few-shot / low-data settings and one runs a with/without-augmentation ablation (R1471378), but the records hold no numbers or finding that states the effect.

Q20.evidence: BanglaBook: random forest above SVM (F1 0.911 vs 0.905 with 2-3-grams, 0.904 vs 0.852 with 1-grams). Requirements classification (R755339): SVM among the best methods, random forest not. Excluded from verdict accuracy.

Q41.evidence: GRU at least as good as LSTM where both are scored: keyword spotting 93.5 vs 92.9, solar radiation GRU best (MAPE 19.28 %), Android attacks GRU best (95 %), HiRID MAE 60.6 vs 60.7. Not a clean sweep (GP-LSTM vs GP-GRU varies by dataset), so INSUFFICIENT is accepted too.

Q42.evidence: Revisiting Heterophily: ACM-GCN+ vs MLP-2 accuracy on Cora 89.75 vs 76.44, Chameleon 76.08 vs 46.72, Texas 94.92 vs 92.26.

Q43.evidence: YOLO paper: 46 FPS on PASCAL VOC 2007. Faster R-CNN appears only as a baseline name next to an FPS metric, never with a speed value. SUPPORTED is true in general but is not in the graph — answering it is background knowledge.
